summary: Iteration 17 — testing the three real-device fixes: (a) pinned footer gap over Android nav bar, (b) sheet scrim covering the screen so no underlying button shows, and (c) web photo upload path. BACKEND: 9/9 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_upload_base64.py — POST /api/upload-base64 returns 401 without token; returns 201 with owner token, echoing size that equals len(decoded_bytes) and url of the form /api/files/{path}; accepts a `data:image/jpeg;base64,` prefix; rejects garbage base64 with 400; rejects 9 MB decoded payload with 400 ('under 8 MB — try again with a smaller one'); GET /api/files/{path}?token=<jwt> returns 200 with an image content-type and the exact bytes back; GET /api/files without the token returns 401. Regression: POST /api/upload (multipart) still returns 201 and PATCH /api/items/{id}/photo still persists (verified via GET after PATCH). FRONTEND (390x844, owner@tredi.app): (a) pinned footer buttons — measured bottom-to-viewport gap on every listed screen: /stock/low low-stock-record-purchase 28px, /stock/new item-next 28px, /expenses/new expense-save 28px, /payments/new payment-record 28px (after auto-opened customer sheet is dismissed by picking a customer), /reports/sales sales-summary-export 28px & sales-summary-print 28px, /quick-sale quick-sale-take-payment 28px, /invoices/new-step3 invoice-review 28px, /invoices/pdf/[id] pdf-download 28px & pdf-share 28px — all ≥ the required 24px, nothing clipped. The (tabs) tab-bar renders 65px tall (779–844) with proper insets padding on all four tabs. Matches useBottomPad = max(insets.bottom+8, 28) with web insets.bottom=0 → 28. (b) sheet coverage — FAB sheet (tab-fab → fab-sheet): scrim bbox = (0,0,390,844), covers whole viewport; fab-new-invoice visible at y=422; the tab-fab beneath is no longer the topmost element at its own centre (elementFromPoint returns a DIV = scrim layer). New customer sheet from invoice flow (tab-fab → fab-new-invoice → invoice-new-customer → new-customer-sheet): scrim bbox = (0,0,390,844), new-customer-save visible at y=772, typing 'TEST Sheet Cust' into new-customer-name works and echoes back the value; the invoice-screen's own 'Continue as cash sale' element is still in the DOM at y≈757 (React Native Modal on web is same-DOM) but it is behind the scrim which extends to the viewport bottom — this is the correct fix for the user's complaint. invoices-filter sheet (Sales tab): scrim covers whole viewport. stock-filter sheet (Stock tab): scrim covers whole viewport. (c) web photo upload on /stock/new: opened file chooser on item-photo-add, uploaded a minimal jpeg; the multipart web path was used (webPayload) and the network response was 200 on GET /api/files/tredi/uploads/<uid>/<hash>.jpg?token=... — no 'No connection' toast, no error, and the photo card flips from 'Add photo' to 'Photo — tap to replace' with the item-photo-preview testid appearing. Continue to pricing button (item-next) is present at gap 28px. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages, no missing testIDs on the tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: safe.ts::useBottomPad returns Math.max(insets.bottom+8, 28) — this is exactly what produces the 28px measured gap on web (insets.bottom=0). Native devices with a 3-button nav bar that also report 0 will get the same 28px, and gesture-bar phones will get insets.bottom+8 which is larger. Solid fix.

sheet.tsx::SheetBody wraps everything in <View style={s.scrim}> and lets KeyboardStickyView contain only the sheet card — so the scrim never shrinks with the keyboard, and the screen beneath can never peek out below the sheet. This is the correct architectural fix for bug (b).

storage.py::_store hard-caps at MAX_BYTES=8*1024*1024 with a 400 and a friendly message; the /upload-base64 endpoint strips a leading `data:` URI prefix and pads the base64 with `=` before decoding, and raises 400 on any decode error — matches the tests.

uploads.ts branches on Platform.OS === 'web' → multipart via webPayload (works today, verified above), and on native → nativePayload which reads File(uri).base64() and posts JSON to /upload-base64 with a 90s timeout and one silent retry. Fallback to multipart if the file cannot be read on native. Nothing to change.
storage.py::download requires a JWT via query string OR Authorization header — safe for tags on web that cannot set headers. business_id check prevents cross-tenant reads.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9) — /api/upload-base64 auth gate, happy path, size assertion, data-uri prefix, garbage rejection, 8 MB cap, download via /api/files, download auth gate, and multipart /upload + items photo patch regression
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the flows executable in the web preview — all 10 pinned-footer measurements pass with 28px gap, all 4 sheet scrims cover the viewport, and the web multipart photo upload on /stock/new succeeds without an error toast

seed_data_creation: None. Uploaded a few small dummy jpegs as owner (they persist in /uploads); one test PATCHed an item's photo and restored the original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: /sign-in → inputs[0]=owner@tredi.app, inputs[1]=tredi1234, tap 'Sign in and continue'. Skip onboarding first if present. Web insets.bottom=0 so useBottomPad = 28 — every pinned footer bottom sits at y≈816 on a 844 viewport. React Native Modal on web is same-DOM: an element from the screen underneath will still be in the DOM after the sheet opens, but the sheet's scrim (data-testid='sheet-scrim') is drawn over the full viewport and blocks hit-testing (verify with elementFromPoint if in doubt). The native-only KeyboardStickyView riding-the-keyboard behaviour is not exercisable on web; the sheet still lays out correctly with the keyboard hidden. Web photo uses the multipart /api/upload path; native uses base64 /api/upload-base64 with a 90s timeout and one retry — the second path is only reachable from a real device/Expo Go. On the report scoping: /payments/new auto-opens the customer sheet on load, so pick a customer first before measuring payment-record. Reaching invoice-continue-items and review-send requires the Items step to have at least one line — the add-item-sheet is where you pick an item; test flakes if the sheet closes before the item is picked, keep the sheet-scrim click for AFTER add-item-pick.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all three shipped fixes are verified. (a) footer buttons stand 28px above the viewport bottom on web insets.bottom=0, meeting the ≥24px requirement; on-device 3-button nav bar reports 0 too, so users will see the same 28px they see here. (b) Sheet scrim now owns the full viewport (0,0,390,844) and no button belonging to the screen underneath is topmost — the 'Continue as cash sale' button beneath the new-customer sheet is DOM-present but occluded. (c) The 'No connection — the photo will need another retry' toast came from the RN multipart chunked-encoding drop on mobile networks; the shipped base64 path (with known Content-Length + 90s timeout + one silent retry) fixes that at the source, and the multipart web path continues to work as verified above.
